o1: Involved in defense response to other organism, including the innate immune response; defense response to bacterium; and defense response to Gram-negative bacterium. Enables lysozyme activity. Predicted to enable lysozyme activity. Is expressed in head neurons; intestine; and rectal gland cell. Predicted to interact with CLEC-60, CLEC-61, CLEC-62, CLEC-63, F54D5.3, ZK1320.2, W03D2.6, and THN-2. Used to study enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection; Serratia marcescens infection; and shigellosis.
